changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has for years sought a deal to obtain American nuclear technology. The agreement, signed on Wednesday, could deepen U.S.-Saudi ties for decades to come.

changes.title: See How Houthis Put the Red Sea at Risk as an Alternative Oil Route
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia has diverted huge amounts of oil to the Red Sea since the Iran war began, but now the Iranian-backed Houthi militants say that they intend to block that route.

changes.title: Critics warn U.S. nuclear power deal with Saudi Arabia could fuel proliferation
changes.summary: The U.S. and Saudi Arabia announced a landmark deal that would give the kingdom a civilian nuclear program using American technology, and might allow for uranium enrichment in Saudi Arabia. Critics warn it could lead to further nuclear proliferation. Nick Schifrin reports and Geoff Bennett discusses more with John Wolf.

changes.title: How the Trump Administration’s Nuclear Deal With Saudi Arabia May Work
changes.summary: The Trump administration announced an agreement with Saudi Arabia on a civilian nuclear program. Such deals, known as 123 Agreements, are designed to prevent the development of weapons.
